summary: Comprehensive testing of Staff Profile page completed successfully. All backend APIs working correctly, frontend navigation and staff profile features functional, shift swaps correctly restricted to staff-only visibility.

ui_bugs.issue: Some modal interactions had overlay interception issues during automated testing

passed_tests: Backend API: Staff Profile returns comprehensive data (leave balance, upcoming shifts, pending requests)
Backend API: My Rota returns shifts for next 4 weeks with swap functionality
Backend API: Today's Shift returns shift info and clocking window (30min before to 2hrs after)
Backend API: Shift Swaps returns empty list for managers/admins (staff-only feature working)
Backend API: Shift Swaps allows staff to create, accept, and cancel swap requests
Backend API: Leave Requests allows creating annual/sick leave with 28 days entitlement
Backend API: Day Requests allows creating day on/off requests
Backend API: Staff Colleagues returns list for shift swap targeting
Frontend: Staff Profile page loads with 'Welcome, Emma' message
Frontend: Overview tab shows leave balance (28 total), upcoming shifts (12), pending requests (2), open swaps (1)
Frontend: My Rota tab displays shifts table with 12 Swap buttons for scheduled shifts
Frontend: Shift Swaps tab shows 'Available Swaps from Colleagues' and 'My Swap Requests' sections
Frontend: Annual Leave tab shows 28 days total entitlement, 0 days used, 28 days remaining
Frontend: Request Leave modal opens and accepts form input correctly
Frontend: Request Day On/Off modal opens and works correctly
Frontend: Shift swap modal opens when clicking Swap buttons in rota
Frontend: Staff Dashboard shows 'No Shift Scheduled Today' when no shift exists
Frontend: Staff Dashboard redirects to profile page via 'Go to My Profile' button
Frontend: Clock In/Out button navigates between dashboard and profile correctly
Frontend: Manager Dashboard shows correct stats and attendance table
Frontend: Manager role cannot access shift swaps (staff-only feature confirmed)
Frontend: Sick Leave tab shows Record Absence button
Frontend: Day Requests tab shows New Request button
Frontend: All sidebar navigation tabs work correctly (Overview, My Rota, Shift Swaps, Annual Leave, Sick Leave, Day Requests)
